what_happened: Early load-bearing finding: box is time-invariant in every TaskModel by shift closure (plusTruthAt_timeShift + box_iff), and stab is state-determined (stab_state_only, in tree). The (W) record's 'for every time, the box anchor across the whole slice' collapses to one global bit per box-subformula; the anchor layer of a closure-wide object is finite with a syntactic bound by construction. Scheduling a scratch machine-check of box time-invariance.

Two scratch machine-checks compiled green via lake env lean on existing oleans (no lake build needed): (1) box_time_invariant / box_global -- the box clause has one truth value per model, from plusTruthAt_timeShift; (2) modelOf_not_sat_Phi / modelOf_incomplete -- every (S)-constructed modelOf validates NoFiniteWidth.Phi.neg (a Z-time non-validity) because frameOf is a finite-width ofSlicedStep frame, a one-line corollary of no_finite_width_sat. Both axiom-profile [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Scratch files in the session scratchpad, not in the tree.

Third scratch machine-check green: stab_iff_of_presented_nowUnique -- at any Presented seam whose presentation marks at most one now state (Cons.nowUnique, which (S) found necessary), every closure formula psi satisfies psi <-> stab psi at the seam. So trace-level Presented cannot witness a stab-refutation such as Fp -> stab Fp; (W)'s realization hypothesis must be Hit-level or product-level. Copied the three compiled scratch files into the task's evidence/ directory as planner inputs (not wired, not in the tree).

Research report written and return-meta finalized (status researched). Nothing blocked this dispatch: no gate collision, no MCP failure (lean-lsp not needed; grep plus lake env lean compilation served as existence and correctness checks), no build run. One documentation drift noted for the plan: RaySummary/README.md line table lists Realize 953 / Compose 298 against measured 1004 / 297.

Planning rested on three research-compiled scratch files (box_time_invariant, modelOf_incomplete, stab_iff_of_presented_nowUnique); every substrate name the plan cites was re-resolved by grep during planning with zero drift, so no phase is costed on an uncompiled claim.
